name: Conformance: WASM Pack ABI Mismatch (Refused at Load)
description: node-pack-runtimes.md §WASM fixture. Invokes `vendor.openwop.misbehaving.abi-bomb`, whose module reports `openwop_abi_version()` 999, which no host lists. A host advertising this fixture says its operator offered `conformance/fixtures/wasm-packs/misbehaving-abi/` to its loader; a conforming host rejected the pack at load, so `nodePackRuntimes.wasm.loadedPacks` (when advertised) omits it, and the run is refused at creation or ends without the node completing. Fixture-only; not signed for the registry.
